messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: p99 latency for /v1/generate exceeded 2.2s (window=5m). SLO p99=1.5s. PagerDuty page fired -> INC12345 to oncall rotation.

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty: Page INC12345 fired at 2026-03-15T14:12:56Z. Routing to @alex_oncall.

alex_oncall: ack — I'm on it, jumping in. Where's the quick dashboard link? :eyes:

julia_sre: looking now. us-west gen cluster p99 ~ 3.2s right now, error rate low. KV-cache eviction spikes line up with latency.

meera: autoscaler appears healthy, sidecar CPU fine. GPU queue depth shows waits ~200ms, but KV eviction log lines are frequent.

alex_oncall: immediate plan: 1) activate regional fallback -> route us-west traffic to us-east 2) reduce batching window to 16ms 3) scale +2 nodes if available. Doing step 1 now. /run playbooks/fallback/regional_reroute

pagerduty-bot: INC12345 acknowledged by alex_oncall at 2026-03-15T14:13:24Z.

julia_sre: runbook quick checks: 
```bash
# quick checks
kubectl -n inference get pods -l app=generator -o jsonpath='{.items[*].status.containerStatuses[*].restartCount}'
redis-cli info | grep evicted_keys
```

meera: log snippet: `2026-03-15T14:12:10Z generator-3 env: KV eviction threshold hit: evicted=312 latency_ms=3200` — pasting from node logs.

sam_platform: scaling request sent to Dedicated pool +2 nodes (request id r-8421). ETA ~45s for nodes to be ready.

alex_oncall: reroute in flight. product-observability-bot, any user-facing reports? customers complaining?

product-observability-bot: Synthetic monitors show p95/p99 increase for /v1/generate in us-west region starting 14:11Z. Customer-facing error rate unchanged; some customers in us-west see ~10% higher RTs. No 5xx spike.

julia_sre: mitigation candidate: enable prefix-KV caching for hot endpoints (should cut repeated KV lookups). Preparing toggle.

meera: prefix-cache toggle applied to prod/gen-hotkey. Observability: p99 dropped from 3.2s -> 1.8s in us-west within ~30s.

alex_oncall: good progress. Keep an eye for bounce. If p99 < 1.6s for three consecutive windows, we can resolve PD. Otherwise, prepare to rollback any config canary rolled at ~13:58. Any rollouts around then?

mike_prod: we rolled quant-tune v3-canary at 13:58 to gen fleet. Rolling back canary now (manual revert).

sam_platform: Dedicated nodes are up, pods scheduled, and draining complete on old nodes. Scaling finished.

pagerduty-bot: INC12345 resolved by alex_oncall at 2026-03-15T14:15:55Z — resolution: regional reroute + prefix-cache + canary rollback.

alex_oncall: post-incident items: probable root cause = KV cache eviction cascade triggered by quantization canary memory pattern. Follow-ups: 1) fully revert canary until mem profile investigation 2) add eviction early-warning alert (thresholds + trend) 3) add canary memory/eviction regression test in CI. Assigning julia_sre, mike_prod, meera.

meera: creating follow-up ticket INF-4321 and scheduling retro for tomorrow 10:00 PT.

alice_engineering: nice work team :thumbsup: rapid coordination and clean rollback.

alex_oncall: closing thread — will update ticket with logs and timeline. Thanks everyone.
